recipient.description: The phone number to verify in international format.

originator.description: The sender ID for the verification message.

reference.description: A client reference for tracking purposes.

type.description: The delivery channel for the verification token.

template.description: A custom message template. Use %token to indicate where the token should be placed.

datacoding.description: The encoding for the SMS message body.

timeout.description: The expiration time of the token in seconds.

tokenLength.description: The number of digits in the verification token.

voice.description: The voice gender for text-to-speech delivery.
